entities.summary: Jean Portante is a Luxembourgish writer who resides in Paris. He has written novels, stories, plays, journalistic articles and poetry, and has been widely translated. Jean Portante was a authors & novelists from Differdange (b. 1950-12-19, Differdange). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
